remarks: Beautifully updated second-floor apartment featuring 4 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, extra room perfect for a home office. This sun-filled unit offers a flexible layout ideal for large family. The main level includes a large living room with plenty of natural light, a spacious eat-in kitchen with room for a full dining table, and two bedrooms. Enjoy brand-new flooring and fresh paint throughout. The upper level offers a second living area, two bedrooms, and an extra. Nice the private deck perfect for summer BBQs and outdoor enjoyment. Conveniently located just 5 minutes from the train station, with easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Close to shopping malls, restaurants, and within walking distance to the beach, this home offers the perfect combination of space, comfort, and convenience.
